annotations.title: Price an ad, image or video

description: Prices a request without making it: the most it can cost in credits, the dollar figures behind it, any warnings, and a quote that is good for about 10 minutes. Free. The body takes the same fields as ugcfans_make_ad, ugcfans_make_image or ugcfans_make_video, without the quote; the make tool takes the quote back and refuses it if any field changed.

body.description: The request: the fields of the make tool for this kind, without quote.
